# America's Country

> Premier internet radio station broadcasting three decades of country music, spanning 1990s country classics, 2000s hits, and contemporary country music.

## Quick Links
- **Website:** https://americascountry.us
- **Listen Live:** https://americascountry.us/#listen
- **LLC / Operator:** SuiteSounds Entertainment, LLC

## Programming & Format
- **Genres & Formats:** Mainstream Country, 90s Country, 2000s Country, Contemporary Country.
- **Morning Show:** *The John & Heidi Show* (Weekdays).
- **Specialty Shows:** *Texas Countdown* (Saturdays at 12:00 PM / Noon Mountain Time).

## Smart Home & Voice Integration
- **Amazon Alexa Skill:** Enable the "America's Country" skill on Amazon Alexa devices.
- **Voice Command:** Say *"Alexa, play America's Country"* or *"Alexa, open America's Country"*.

## Audio Stream Specifications
The station delivers high-fidelity audio processing optimized for both mobile networks and desktop audio setups.

- **Standard Stream:** 128 kbps LC-AAC (Advanced Audio Coding - Low Complexity)
- **Mobile / Low-Bandwidth Stream:** 64 kbps HE-AAC (High-Efficiency Advanced Audio Coding)
